# Overtime terminology fixtures

Public production `/game/NFL/401873024` (Cardinals–Cowboys) and `/game/NFL/401873031` (Titans–Bengals) responses captured before deployment from `https://sports-radar-alerts.mmueller918.workers.dev`, while Pages was at `39059fa99d066f06474af23d7ffb149568cc2fc8`.

Each gzip contains `{capturedAt, detail}`. The original decisive moments begin `Period 5 · 2:53` and `Period 5 · 7:00`; ratings are 95 and 79. These fixtures include the unchanged provider period numbers, play text and recorded history. Tests use the real responses without rewriting their contents.
